title: Stepin Fetchit and Muhammad Ali
summary: Butler thinks Fetchit influenced Muhammad Ali's fighting and the Elijah Muhammad circle, recalling an anecdote of Fetchit teaching a lady to dance.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I think Stepen Fetchit has a lot to do with Mohammed's fighting. Because I can see things in what Stepen Fetchit's (logically) and everything, because that have a lot to do with Elijah and all that. Did you know that?

Oh, yeah, Stepen Fetchit he was a mind, man, a brilliant mind. Because I can see---- Do you remember when Wallace -- while Stepen Fetchit was teaching a lady how to dance or something, and Wallace was here, and all of a sudden, Wallace kind of got away from the woman.
I could see it right away. He was teaching her to dance, and Stepen Fetchit's not a dancer, he's an actor. So there we go. (Laughter).
